title: campanula fenestrellata subsp. istriaca
intro: Campanula fenestrellata subsp. istriaca, commonly known as Istrian bellflower, is a plant species belonging to the Campanulaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Campanula fenestrellata subsp. istriaca include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions like bronchitis and coughs. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
